label: Extensions
description: Catalog of the 13 Marked extensions in 18.0.0 with their package, default export, browser behavior and the Markdown syntax each one parses.
excerpt: Every extension is its own npm package, published as 18.0.

label: Accordion
description: Collapsible sections from fenced accordion blocks, rendered as native details elements with native exclusive groups, variants and front matter.
excerpt: turns a fenced block into a native element.

label: Alert
description: GitHub-style callouts from blockquotes that start with a [!TYPE] marker, with 11 built-in types, inline titles, icon overrides and custom variants.
excerpt: converts a blockquote that starts with into a styled alert.

label: Comments
description: Inline and fenced block review comments with author, type, status, priority, reply threads and parse-time visibility filters.
excerpt: metadata, reply threads ( ) and parse-time filters. It needs no browser JavaScript.

label: Embeds
description: Fenced embed blocks that render sandboxed iframes for YouTube, Vimeo, CodePen, Spotify, Figma and 15 more providers, with URL scheme checks.
excerpt: turns a fenced block into a responsive (or a Mermaid ).

label: Footnote
description: Numbered, named and inline footnotes with backlinks, CSS hover previews and an endnotes section placed automatically or with a placeholder.
excerpt:

a numbered endnotes . No setup call is needed in the browser, but with (the...

label: Kanban
description: Kanban boards from fenced kanban blocks, with board, table and list views, WIP limits, card metadata and opt-in drag and drop.
excerpt: renders a fenced block as a board.

label: Lists
description: Alphabetic and Roman ordered lists, start and skipped values, accessible task checkboxes, a delegated checkbox callback and list-editing helpers.
excerpt: replaces Marked's list tokenizer and renderer.

label: Slide
description: Slide decks from fenced presentation blocks, with layouts, backgrounds, transitions, themes, autoplay, speaker view and an injected navigation script.
excerpt: renders a fenced block as a slide deck.

label: Spoiler
description: Hidden content behind a themed overlay from fenced spoiler blocks, revealed by click or keyboard through a document-level listener.
excerpt: hides the content of a fenced block behind an overlay.

label: Tables
description: Tables with column spanning (||), row spanning (^), multi-row headers, captions, footers and an optional responsive wrapper.
excerpt: extends GFM tables with cell spanning, captions and footers.

label: Tabs
description: Tabbed content from fenced tabs blocks, rendered as CSS-only radio tabs with variants, animations and an auto-attached keyboard and persistence runtime.
excerpt: inline block that shows the checked panel.

label: Timeline
description: Chronological timelines from fenced timeline blocks, with date ranges, active events, groups, collapsible events, milestone and group-by-year modes.
excerpt: renders a fenced block as a list of dated events.

label: Typographic
description: SmartyPants-style quotes, dashes and ellipses, fractions, and (:name:) symbol shortcodes for Greek letters, math, arrows, currency and emoji.
